question: Should a weekly loss circuit-breaker threshold be 5x the daily threshold (linear), or some other multiple?
summary: Derived the square-root-of-time rule (weekly ~= daily x sqrt(5) ~= 2.24x) from variance additivity under i.i.d. daily returns, plus a fat-tail/autocorrelation margin above that. Corpus confirms this is the standard square-root-of-time VaR scaling rule with the same caveats. WOLF's own live config (daily limit ~-3.0%, weekly ~-7.0%, ratio 2.33x) already sits close to this theoretical multiple rather than the naive 5x linear one.
